notes.title: Update Notes for Sep 22
notes.content:
This update brings some more adjustments and bug fixes. Here's what has changed:

[list]
* Reduced the max inventory space to 26 slots (2 pages)
* Soldiers won't explode on death anymore, but instead 3 turns after they have activated their grenades
* Cloned enemies will not immediately be able to take a turn
* Fixed spelling errors in the compendium
* Fixed an issue where Trapsters would put down traps without an animation or message
* Fixed an issue where sorting the storage would make empty storage slots disappear
* Fixed an issues where soldier would explode without showing tile indicators
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes For Sep 18
notes.content:
Hey, this update brings some new features, bug fixes and adjustments. Here's what has changed:

[list]
[*] You can now suspend and temporarily save your game when entering the next floor of a dungeon. added suspend feature
[*] The Darkseed now has the ability to burrow itself after being uprooted making the fight more interesting
[*] Throwing a Push Hex on stacked enemies will now make them swap positions
[*] Added an error message when the Push Hex can't be used, instead of letting it go to waste
[*] Rebalanced the damage values and max level of the "Godslayer"
[*] Changed the description of the "Trapper" trait, it also now ignores traps rather then disabling them
[*] Changed "End run" menu item to "Quit (no save)" when in a dungeon
[*] The amount of bonus rewards of the post game dungeons are now based on turns taken
[*] Fixed an issue where using an item via the "Examine" option would always use the whole stack
[*] Fixed an issue where the eyes of a Sentinel would still be visible after death
[*] Fixed an issue where Sentinels would return to stone even after being hit the turn before
[*] Fixed a typo for antidote spell and spell book
[*] Fixed an issue where leveling an enemy up would fill up their hp even when affected by the "one hp" dungeon modifier
[*] Fixed an issue where Ravagers would get stuck in their animation when killed by the Thorns trait
[*] Fixed display name issues of identified serums
[*] Fixed an issue where healing serums would not show the amount it really heals
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would sometimes crash when summoning enemies
[*] Items won't  drop on unrevealed Cursed Jars anymore
[*] Adjusted the inventory / equipment formatting on the result screen
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for Dec 31
notes.content:
Hello! This will be the last update of 2024! Thanks for all the support and I hope that you all have a happy new year 2025! This update brings the item identification system back as well as some more minor fixes. Here's what has changed:

[list]
[*] Items with traits now have to be identified to see what their traits are
[*] Adjusted drop chance of rare items
[*] Enemies may now spawn as their fowl version which drop better loot
[*] Equipping an item now shows a message in the message log 
[*] The "Push Hex" now shows a message when the path was blocked
[*] The "Warp" trap now shows a message that you got warped
[*] The "Plus" value of an item now also has green or red coloring depending on if it's higher or lower than the "Plus" value of your current item
[*] The item box now also shows placeholder lines for empty slots like the inventory
[*] Fixed an issue where it was possible to rotate the camera while viewing the inventory
[*] Changed the description of permanent upgrade items to reflect that they are permanent
[*] Fixed an issue where confused enemies wouldn't move at all sometimes
[*] The enemie's status indicators should now be properly hidden when casting spells
[*] Added a loading screen at the beginning for shader precompilation
[*] The "Riposte" trait shouldn't trigger anymore after moving
[*] Messages in the message log can now be multiline
[*] Improved the scrolling in message log
[/list] 

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Upgrade Notes for Dec 21 (DEMO.211224)
notes.content:
Hello! I've been working on a public demo that will be playable before the actual release of the game. Therefore, the playtest will now focus on this demo version of the game, which will cover the first area. With that also comes a lot of major changes. Here's what's new:

[list]
[*] Added "demo mode" which will end the game after the first area
[*] Major balancing changes to the first area of the game
[*] Added new special attacks to the enemies of the first area
[*] Improved the behaviour of the first boss to make the fight more interesting
[*] Removed the combo system
[*] Herbs and hexes now stack up to 10 each
[*] Added a new rarity "unique", which has a yellow color and adds features pre-selected, fixed traits
[*] Enemies will now drop ancient coins again, which can be used to buy items from the vendor
[*] Upgrades will now be obtained via elixirs that can be found in the dungeon or bought
[*] Spells will now be obtained via spellbooks that can be found in the dungeon or bought
[*] You will now need to find or buy pouches to increase your inventory space
[*] Increased the initial inventory size
[*] Most of the gun traits will now be based on chance to hit again. Also increased the chance to drop ammo so that the gun is more useful again.
[*] The maximum level of a piece of equipment is now determined by rarity
[*] All Enemies now have visible health bars
[*] When an enemy "levels up" it will now change to a stronger, "foul" version of itself
[*] And a lot more minor changes and improvements!
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes For Nov 12 (V_TEST.121124)
notes.content:
Hey there! Today's update includes a rework of the trait / equipment system. As this changes some very fundamental things a save file wipe is necessary, which will be automatically applied by installing this update.
Here are all the changes:

[list]
[*] New trait / equipment system: Equipment will now be colored according to their rarity instead of level. The rarity determines how many traits the item will have, from zero for the most common ones, to 3 for the rarest. Leveling an item up will no longer add additional traits to the item
[*] Changed some of the melee traits that would trigger per chance on hit (like Gluey or Dreaded) to be ranged traits instead
[*] All ranged weapon traits but "Lucky" will now be triggered on every hit instead of per chance
[*] Added 5 new traits to melee weapons
[*] Finding ammo will now be more rare. The maximum stack size of ammo has also been reduced to 10
[*] Upgrade kits can now level up equipment beyond level 10 to a maximum of level 99
[*] Throwing armor equipment will now deal more damage
[*] The "Evacuation Map" item will now teleport you to the next exit
[*] Teleporting via the "Evacuation Map" and "Warp Serum" will no longer take a turn
[*] A message will be displayed when trying to poison an immune enemy
[*] The controls hint will now be hidden after the first level in the tutorial run
[*] The attack patterns of the third boss should now be more obvious
[*] The invisible effect of the third boss should now be more apparent
[*] Fixed an issue where the debuff indicators would still show on the third boss when it clears all debuffs
[*] The second boss will now be able to fight back again
[*] Fixed an issue where you could see items on the floor through wall corners
[*] Fixed an issue where the slime type enemies would not split correctly on death
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for Oct 31 (V_TEST.311024)
notes.content:
Hey there! This new update brings a lot of changes, bugfixes and new features. As always, here are the highlights:

[list]
[*] 2 new bosses added! The garden and caves both now have their own unique boss to fight!
[*] Added Upgrade System. You can now spend a special currency to upgrade your character permanently.
[*] Added Spell System. You can now learn spells that will be useful on your adventures!
[*] Added Item Trading NPC. There's now a special NPC that will allow you to trade valuable items for a special currency.
[*] Reworked shortcut unlocks. Shortcuts are now unlocked earlier, right after you beat the boss of an area
[*] Enemy AI overhaul. This is basically a rewrite of the AI and pathfinding system, which fixed a couple of bugs and also makes enemies behave more consistently
[*] Cave entrance visual overhaul. Beautiful!
[*] Equipment stats now indicate via color if they're an upgrade or not
[*] Dead enemies now fade away after some time to make it less visually cluttered when there are a lot of them on the same tile
[*] Your attacks while being invisible will now always be a critical hit
[*] Monster Flesh was renamed to Blood Flask
[*] Lots of smaller bugfixes, improvements and balancing tweaks!
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes for October 20
notes.content:
It's been a pretty productive week, so there are a lot of changes in this build. Here's a few of the highlights:

[list]
[*] The "Outside" is back! Teleport back to the hubworld safely, but beware - you will only take your equipped items with you!
[*] A new weapon speed / combo system has been introduced. There are now different weapon types that affect this new "Speed" stat. Probably still needs some fine-tuning. Let me know what you think!
[*] New equipment EXP system. You can now level up equipment by wearing / using it. This is an alternative way to level up equipment besides using Upgrade Kits.
[*] New meta-progression purpose for the "Monster Flesh" item, check the description of this item for more information!
[*] Updated storage system. You can now store and retrieve as many items as you want when you are at a storage box. Store useful items for your next run! 
[*] Equipment description UI overhaul. Stats of equipment should now be a bit more clear. The flavor text for most items is still WIP, though!
[*] Adjusted game difficulty based on player feedback. Probably not the last time.
[*] And lots of more bugfixes, additions, etc...
[/list]

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update Notes For Jun 21 (V_TEST.210624C)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now unequip equipped items
[*] As an experiment to make frequent deaths less frustrating you will now keep 75% of your current coins when dying. This might need some more adjustments, so feedback is welcome!
[*] Gamepad controls are now documented in the "Controls" option
[*] Using a Blue Herb when you're not poisoned now correctly shows that it has no effect
[*] Readjusted price calculation formula for the items in the shop
[*] Fixed an issue where dropped items would appear 1 tile further away than intended
[*] Adjusted Vampiric Hex damage and healing values
[*] Floorplan now also shows hidden traps
[*] Ammunition drops more frequently and has a max stack size of 20 now
[*] You shouldn't be able to teleport behind the door anymore
[*] The volume options can now be controlled by pressing the "left" and "right" action
[*] You shouldn't be able to teleport to the same tile or the tile next to you anymore
[*] You can now cancel the Boss's charge animation with certain items / effects
[*] It's not possible anymore to use the Escape Hex when there is not enough space to actually use it
[*] You can now directly access the inventory by pressing "I" or "TAB" on the keyboard or "Left Trigger / L2" on the gamepad
[*] For gamepad users: Shooting is now on "Y / Triangle" while "B / Circle" is now used to close menus / cancel
[/list]
